summary: Re-verified the bottom tab-bar label clipping fix in /app/frontend/app/(app)/_layout.tsx. Logged in as dealer (dave@fourbuy.co.za) and measured computed height of every tab label at BOTH desktop (1440x900) and mobile-web (390x844) viewports. All four labels — Home, My Vehicles, Submit, Profile — are now FULLY visible (heights 13px for Home/My Vehicles/Profile and 15px for Submit; matches the 11px font-size + a couple pixels of descender room). Previous iteration_37 defect (labels clipped to 1px because of tabBarItemStyle.paddingVertical) is resolved. Visual screenshots also confirm the labels render cleanly under each icon with no truncation at either viewport.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab-bar label clipping fix is verified on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile-web (390x844) viewports. Labels render at 13-15px height with bottom edge well inside viewport. No further re-testing needed for this specific bug.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (from iteration_37): tabBarItemStyle set paddingVertical which shrank the inner item area to ~1px in every non-active tab, clipping the label. Fix (verified this iteration): removed tabBarItemStyle entirely, bumped tab-bar container to height 76 with paddingTop 8 / paddingBottom 12, and centered the label with symmetric marginTop/marginBottom of 2. Result: labels now render at their natural 13-15px height on both viewports.
